items.heading: Pepper Soup
details: Key ingredients: fish or goat meat, chili, ginger, spices
Simmer fish or goat meat with ginger and garlic in water.
Add ground chili and local spices for heat and aroma.
Cook until the meat is tender and the broth is fragrant.
Serve hot as a warming, spicy soup.

items.heading: Succotash
details: Key ingredients: corn, beans, palm oil, fish or meat
Cook corn kernels and beans together until tender.
Saute fish or meat with onion and palm oil.
Combine the corn and beans with the sauteed meat.
Simmer briefly to blend flavors before serving.
